item.title: LG Ends McAfee Pop‑Up Ads on Windows 11 After Microsoft
item.description: LG will disable the intrusive McAfee pop‑up ads from its Monitor App Installer on Windows 11 after Microsoft stepped in over silent updates.

item.title: Microsoft Forces LG to Stop McAfee Ads in Windows 11
item.description: Microsoft pressured LG to disable intrusive McAfee trial pop‑ups delivered via the LG Monitor App Installer on Windows 11, ending unwanted bloatware.
